The Beatles - Two Of Us (Performance from ‘Let It Be’)
snippet.description:
This performance of “Two Of Us” was originally featured in Let It Be (1970) and later included in  the end credits of Peter Jackson’s Get Back.

Written by Paul McCartney (credited to Lennon–McCartney), the song was recorded in January 1969 during the band’s famous rooftop-era sessions and released as the opening track on the Let It Be album. Built around acoustic guitars and close harmonies from Paul and John, “Two Of Us” captures a warm, nostalgic spirit that reflects their early songwriting partnership.

A timeless moment of harmony and friendship, the song continues to resonate with new audiences—newly featured in the film Project Hail Mary.

en.title: The Beatles - Two Of Us (Performance from ‘Let It Be’)
en.description:
This performance of “Two Of Us” was originally featured in Let It Be (1970) and later included in  the end credits of Peter Jackson’s Get Back.

Written by Paul McCartney (credited to Lennon–McCartney), the song was recorded in January 1969 during the band’s famous rooftop-era sessions and released as the opening track on the Let It Be album. Built around acoustic guitars and close harmonies from Paul and John, “Two Of Us” captures a warm, nostalgic spirit that reflects their early songwriting partnership.

A timeless moment of harmony and friendship, the song continues to resonate with new audiences—newly featured in the film Project Hail Mary.

snippet.title: “One of the great things, and one of the wonderful things about The Beatles...“ (read description)
snippet.description: “One of the great things, and one of the wonderful things about The Beatles... they were the first I ever recall White artists to come out and say that they were influenced by Black music and how much they loved Motown... That was so wonderful to hear them come out and say something like that, and giving Black music that kind of a boost to the fans of theirs, who were not aware of that, because we were all Beatles fans, of course, who wasn't. It was great.” - Smokey Robinson

id.title: “Salah satu hal hebat, dan salah satu hal menakjubkan tentang The Beatles...” (baca deskripsi)
id.description: “Salah satu hal hebat, dan salah satu hal menakjubkan tentang The Beatles... mereka adalah artis kulit putih pertama yang saya ingat yang secara terbuka mengatakan bahwa mereka dipengaruhi oleh musik Black dan betapa mereka mencintai Motown... Sungguh luar biasa mendengar mereka mengatakan hal seperti itu, dan memberikan dorongan bagi musik Black kepada para penggemar mereka, yang tidak menyadarinya, karena kami semua adalah penggemar Beatles, tentu saja, siapa yang tidak. Itu hebat.” - Smokey Robinson

hi.title: “बीटल्स के बारे में एक महान और एक अद्भुत बात...“ (विवरण पढ़ें)
hi.description: “बीटल्स के बारे में एक बहुत अच्छी और अद्भुत बात यह थी कि वे पहले ऐसे श्वेत कलाकार थे जिन्होंने खुलकर स्वीकार किया कि वे अश्वेत संगीत से प्रभावित थे और उन्हें मोटाउन कितना पसंद था... उन्हें ऐसा कहते हुए सुनना बहुत ही शानदार था, और इससे उनके उन प्रशंसकों को अश्वेत संगीत के प्रति एक तरह का प्रोत्साहन मिला, जो इससे अनजान थे, क्योंकि हम सभी बीटल्स के प्रशंसक थे, भला कौन नहीं था। यह बहुत बढ़िया था।” - स्मोकी रॉबिन्सन

es-US.title: “Una de las grandes cosas, y una de las cosas maravillosas de The Beatles…” (leer descripción)
es-US.description: Una de las grandes cosas, y una de las cosas maravillosas de los Beatles... fueron los primeros artistas blancos que recuerdo que salieron a decir que estaban influenciados por la música negra y cuánto amaban la Motown... Fue maravilloso escucharlos decir algo así, y darle a la música negra ese impulso a sus fans, que no lo sabían, porque todos éramos fans de los Beatles, claro, ¿quién no? Fue genial. - Smokey Robinson

pt-BR.title: “Uma das grandes coisas, e uma das coisas maravilhosas sobre os Beatles...” (leia a descrição)
pt-BR.description: “Uma das coisas mais incríveis e maravilhosas sobre os Beatles... eles foram os primeiros artistas brancos que me lembro de terem admitido publicamente a influência da música negra e o quanto amavam a Motown... Foi maravilhoso ouvi-los dizer algo assim, dando um impulso à música negra para os fãs deles, que não tinham consciência disso, porque, claro, todos nós éramos fãs dos Beatles, quem não era? Foi ótimo.” - Smokey Robinson

de-DE.title: „Eines der großartigen und wunderbaren Dinge an den Beatles…“ (Beschreibung lesen)
de-DE.description: „Eines der großartigsten und wunderbarsten Dinge an den Beatles war, dass sie die ersten weißen Künstler waren, an die ich mich erinnere, die öffentlich zugaben, von schwarzer Musik beeinflusst zu sein und wie sehr sie Motown liebten. Es war einfach wunderbar, das von ihnen zu hören, und es gab der schwarzen Musik einen enormen Aufschwung bei ihren Fans, die sich dessen nicht bewusst waren, denn wir waren ja alle Beatles-Fans, wer war das nicht? Es war großartig.“ – Smokey Robinson

it.title: "Una delle cose più belle e meravigliose dei Beatles..." (leggi la descrizione)
it.description: "Una delle cose più belle e meravigliose dei Beatles... sono stati i primi artisti bianchi che io ricordi a dire apertamente di essere stati influenzati dalla musica nera e di quanto amassero la Motown... È stato meraviglioso sentirli dire una cosa del genere, e dare alla musica nera una spinta del genere ai loro fan, che non ne erano a conoscenza, perché eravamo tutti fan dei Beatles, ovviamente, e non lo eravamo. È stato fantastico." - Smokey Robinson

en.title: “One of the great things, and one of the wonderful things about The Beatles...“ (read description)
en.description: “One of the great things, and one of the wonderful things about The Beatles... they were the first I ever recall White artists to come out and say that they were influenced by Black music and how much they loved Motown... That was so wonderful to hear them come out and say something like that, and giving Black music that kind of a boost to the fans of theirs, who were not aware of that, because we were all Beatles fans, of course, who wasn't. It was great.” - Smokey Robinson

fr-FR.title: « L’une des grandes qualités, et l’une des plus merveilleuses qualités des Beatles… » (lire la de...
fr-FR.description: « L'une des choses formidables, et l'une des plus merveilleuses concernant les Beatles… c'est qu'ils ont été les premiers artistes blancs, à ma connaissance, à déclarer publiquement avoir été influencés par la musique noire et à exprimer leur admiration pour la Motown… C'était formidable de les entendre dire cela, et de donner ainsi un tel coup de pouce à la musique noire auprès de leurs fans, qui n'en avaient pas conscience, car nous étions tous fans des Beatles, bien sûr. Qui ne l'était pas ? C'était génial. » – Smokey Robinson

snippet.title: Please Please Me • 1963 🖤
snippet.description: "Some of the stuff we've written in the past has been a bit way-out, but we aimed this one straight at the hit parade." - John ‘Please Please Me’ was released as a single with “Ask Me Why” on 11 January 1963.
